action: Do not select solely from general corrosion rating; assess pitting/crevice resistance, temperature, concentration, aeration and stress state.
Perform SCC assessment; generic corrosion resistance is insufficient.
Assess hardness/strength, charging source, traps, stress intensity and fracture/fatigue consequences.
Perform galvanic compatibility assessment including area ratio and electrical isolation/protection.
Record coating/plating/passivation system separately from base-material corrosion capability.
